record.question: Which City hosted the second-summit of US President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong un?
record.explanation: Answer C: Hanoi. The second Trump–Kim summit was held in Hanoi, Vietnam, in February 2019. The White House’s original record places the leaders’ 28 February expanded bilateral meeting at the Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi. Singapore hosted their first summit. Reference: https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/briefings-statements/remarks-president-trump-chairman-kim-jong-un-democratic-peoples-republic-korea-expanded-bilateral-meeting/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
